scope_policy: Numeric replay supports only row-level bounded claims. Official snapshots alone never count as empirical promotion.

rows.claim_scope: calibration replay of an official constant, not a new law of physics
rows.formula: predicted c = SI defining value parsed from NIST CODATA snapshot
rows.negative_control: replace c by 300000000 and residual becomes nonzero
rows.falsifier: NIST snapshot parse does not yield 299792458 m s^-1

rows.split_policy: predeclared formula split fixed before reading PubChem observed field
rows.negative_control: use CO2 formula against water snapshot; formula and residual fail
rows.falsifier: absolute residual exceeds 0.02 u or formula is not H2O

rows.claim_scope: official GEO query-count replay; no organism-wide mechanism claim
rows.formula: predicted count = pinned ESearch count recorded in snapshot
rows.split_policy: snapshot replay only; mechanism claim not promoted
rows.negative_control: query a different accession and require count mismatch
rows.falsifier: replay parser cannot recover the pinned count

rows.claim_scope: one-step GDP replay with comparator, no superiority claim
rows.formula: predict latest non-null WDI value by previous-year growth carry-forward
rows.split_policy: train on two previous non-null years, hold out latest non-null year
rows.negative_control: reverse time order and require split-policy failure

rows.claim_scope: finite witness acceptance count for all promoted v12 theorem rows
rows.formula: predicted accepted cases = theorem inventory rows when finite runner failure_total=0
rows.split_policy: finite replay split generated from theorem registry; negative controls paired per theorem
rows.negative_control: remove a required tuple component and observe rejected stronger reading
rows.falsifier: any finite model case has observed verdict different from expected
